item.title: Learnings on Money
item.description: I am no expert when it comes to finances but I’ve been doing this long enough that my friends believe I can share some nuggets. To start of, the main and greatest lesson I have learnt is personal finance is personal. Although you may have similiarities with your family, neighbours or even friends, when it comes to money - experiences are unique and varied.
